'''Tandry''' was a town in [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was situated between the city of [[Uhrar]] in the north and [[Point Defiance]] in [[Garrow's Neck]] on the far south-west of Alanciar. As of [[2975 BBY]], Tandry was known to have a corral which was home to [[muntok]]s, a mounted reptilian beast of burden, which could be rented to travelers. Prior to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] of Alanciar, the [[wardmaster]] [[Quarra Thayn]] rented a muntok from Tandry before continuing her journey to Point Defiance, which was where her secret lover [[Jogan Halder]] was stationed.
